table_row: A measurement is inserted between two administrations | Treatment-only adjacency can remain; a sequence including measurements must be reevaluated
narrative: Direct succession is scope-relative. Two administrations can be direct successors within a treatment-only scope (S = {administrations}) while a measurement recorded strictly between them breaks that adjacency the moment the scope is widened to S' = {administrations, measurements}. Neither scope is more correct in the abstract; each is a distinct, explicitly declared query.

direct_succession.basis: Measure1 lies strictly between them in this scope
